form.label: 7. Bettenauslastung — Bed Occupancy (Exec View)
form.description: A leadership-level view of bed occupancy by ward — the kind of KPI dashboard that gets shown to GL/executive management, not just operations.

html.blockquote: "Überwachung der Bettenauslastung, kann interessant sein für GL."
html.p: This one came up as a leadership (GL) interest rather than an IT operations problem — occupancy is a business KPI, not a fault to fix. The Splunk angle is the same either way: pull the occupancy signal into one place, trend it by ward over time, and put it in front of the people who make staffing and capacity decisions, instead of it living only inside the bed-management system's own (operational) UI.

panel.title: Data sources needed to build this for real

ul.li: Bed management system / RTLS — real-time bed status (occupied / free / being cleaned / blocked) per ward, usually via its own API or database export.
ADT feed (HL7) — Admission-Discharge-Transfer messages, the clinical system of record for who is in which bed and for how long.
Nurse call system — optional, but useful as a proxy for ward activity level alongside raw occupancy.
Reference data — total licensed beds per ward, so a raw count becomes a meaningful percentage.

search.query: | makeresults | eval trend="+4.2 pts vs. last month"

| makeresults count=30 | streamstats count as i | eval Day=strftime(relative_time(now(), "-".(30-i)."d"), "%m-%d") | eval "Surgery"=78+((i%7)*2) | eval "Internal Medicine"=85+((i%5)*2) | eval "Radiology / Day Clinic"=60+((i%9)*3) | table Day "Surgery" "Internal Medicine" "Radiology / Day Clinic"

| makeresults count=3 | streamstats count as i | eval Ward=case(i=1,"Surgery",i=2,"Internal Medicine",i=3,"Radiology / Day Clinic") | eval "Licensed beds"=case(i=1,40,i=2,52,i=3,20) | eval "Occupied"=case(i=1,35,i=2,49,i=3,13) | eval "Occupancy %"=round('Occupied'/'Licensed beds'*100,1) | eval Status=case('Occupancy %'>=90,"Near capacity",'Occupancy %'>=75,"Healthy",1=1,"Underutilized") | table Ward "Licensed beds" Occupied "Occupancy %" Status

panel.title: The SPL, once the bed-management system / ADT feed is onboarded

html.pre: index=adt_hl7 message_type=ADT | eval bed_status=case(event_type="A01","occupied", event_type="A03","free", 1=1, bed_status) | stats latest(bed_status) as status by ward, bed_id | stats count as licensed_beds, count(eval(status="occupied")) as occupied by ward | eval occupancy_pct=round(occupied/licensed_beds*100,1) | table ward licensed_beds occupied occupancy_pct | sort - occupancy_pct
html.p: Scheduled daily/weekly and shared as a PDF or a Splunk dashboard link, this is a natural fit for a GL/leadership review deck.
